consistency_findings.detail: The abstract reports 12,062 unique records, while the Results text reports 14,797 unique records. Figure 2 shows 12,062 records screened from the previous APA search plus 2,735 database records and 3 supplementary-search records. This extraction does not silently reconcile the discrepancy.

extraction_limitations: The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented toward primary literature, while this source is a systematic review/meta-analysis. Review-level findings are tagged systematic_review; individual trial findings quoted by the review are tagged secondary_reported_result and are not represented as primary-study evidence.

The supplement contains extensive study-by-study tables. The extraction prioritizes independently reviewable review-level methods, pooled estimates, certainty judgments, and high-value secondary-reported findings rather than atomizing every cell of every underlying trial table.
No missing study detail was inferred from outside sources; source-reported gaps remain gaps.
schema_gaps: No dedicated atom kind exists for systematic-review evidence-certainty judgments (e.g., GRADE) or secondary-reported primary-study results; these are represented with existing atom kinds plus descriptive tags.
